g.title: Runs seeds in parallel jobs. 200 seeds took 9.4 s on a laptop, about 87x faster than real time.
The seed number is the whole bug report: same seed, same failure, on any machine.
Prints a determinism hash over every host call; 3 of 3 replays matched exactly. Writes an HTML timeline of messages, faults and the failing check.

ddmin over the fault schedule, then a capped workload, a trimmed duration and simplified faults. A candidate is kept only if it fails with the same class, node, property and message, so shrinking never swaps one bug for another.
Saved as JSON that replay, inspect and verify all accept, so the minimal case can be pinned in CI.
Replays the failing schedule against the patched code and sweeps fresh seeds, so a fix is proven rather than assumed.
